'''Geranites''', also known simply as the '''Geran''', were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Near-Human]]s that inhabited the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Geran/Legends|Geran]] in the [[Mneon system]]. Their features usually consisted of pale shades of purple, blue, green, and pink skin tones, white eyes, and three-digit hands. To survive offworld, they needed to carry special containers filled with [[hydron-three]], and often wore specialized suits to sustain their needs. Their religion was based on a belief in the [[Sky Seraphs]]. [[Doallyn/Legends|Doallyn]] was one of the best known members of the species.
